integrity.computation_role: exact finite rational checks corroborate the algebra and do not replace the all-parameter proof
integrity.proof_basis: exact Johnson-slice kernel reconstruction, hypergeometric factorial moments, a discrete telescoping identity, and a bulk hypergeometric central limit argument with exact \(L^2\) uniform-integrability control

scientific_limitations: The exact theorem is restricted to the degree-two Johnson primitive idempotent.
The asymptotic assumes \(k/n\) tends to a positive limit; sparse slices are not covered by that scaling.
An equivalent absolute-sum identity could exist in older association-scheme literature under a different normalization; no such statement was found in the inspected sources or searches.
title: Exact endpoint norm of the second Johnson spherical projector
